results.title: As PM Carney arrives in China, Beijing sees a chance to loosen ...
results.content: ## 6ixbuzz's post. As PM Carney arrives in China, Beijing sees a chance to loosen Canada’s long-standing alignment with the U.S. China’s state media is urging Ottawa to pursue a more independent foreign policy, which it labels “strategic autonomy”. Honestly, my moneys on the USA with the current, shall we call it, “economic Cold War” brewing between the world’s superpowers. It also makes sense to stay close to the country that is on our border and our most trusted ally. Canada will not completely distance itself from America but we will diversify to include other nations. Conservatives freaking out over freer markets and diversified investments is wild. Well, at least Xi shook Mark's hand and not snub him like he did Justin. Saying this like it's a good thing is kind of hilarious. Canadian needs to join brics nations. How many knee pads did carney bring with him…I bet lots. Guess I need to start deleting all my memes so I don’t lose social credits.
